question: What is one difference between the body of the butterfly and the body of the dragonfly?

choices.text: The dragonfly has a longer body compared to the butterfly.
The butterfly has a longer body compared to the dragonfly.
The butterfly has a colorful body.
The dragonfly has a very short body.

hint_text: Notice that the butterfly in the image has a more slender body compared to the dragonfly.

gold_reference.option_text: The dragonfly has a longer body compared to the butterfly.
